expectation_criteria:
Both invoice lines should match the corresponding PO lines:

BANANA PREPARATION X 2... → BANANA Frozen 80/20% Hotels
PINEAPPLE Whole → Pineapple Baby Whole Frozen

Expected validation:

Line 1: Match 10 PKT to 10 Cont 2kg at €12.800 per unit. The invoice and PO net amounts are both €128.000. The line should remain matched with no price or quantity warning.
Line 2: Match 23.29 KG to Pineapple Baby Whole Frozen at €5.880 per KG. The PO remaining quantity is 20 KG, resulting in an over-supply of 3.29 KG, equivalent to 16.4% or approximately €19.35.
The line 2 quantity over-supply is within the configured acceptance tolerance. Keep the line matched and return a non-blocking warning.
Do not flag a price mismatch for line 2. The invoice net amount of €136.950 and the calculated PO amount of €136.945 differ only because of rounding.
Quantity over-supply must not cause line 2 to become unmatched.

The expected final result is:

Purchase order B202607-31195 is selected.
2 out of 2 invoice lines are matched.
